verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk actions, such as resolving, muting, or assigning many items at once in the UI or through a bulk API endpoint. Item merging, which combines multiple items into a group, is a related but different feature. The List Items API only paginates reads, and per-item statuses and owners are not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
